description:
Ranked full-text search over every page, solution, sector page, case, integration and article of
aiagentcycle.com. Any word may match; documents matching more words rank higher. lang is nl or en.
type optionally narrows to: article, page, integration, case, solution, sector. query max 100 chars,
limit 1-10. Each hit has an id for get_document and the source url.

lang.description: Language of the content: nl (Dutch, the primary site language) or en (English).

limit.description: Maximum number of hits to return, 1 to 10.

query.description: Search words, 1 to 100 characters, in the language of lang, for example 'Exact Online koppeling' or 'AI agent cost'.

type.description: Optional filter on document type: article, page, integration, case, solution or sector. Leave empty for all types.

name: search_knowledge_base
title: Search the AIAgentCycle website
